title: Dispatch completed-build Hostinger log evidence R3

phases.objective: Rotate the existing single-use bridge to a fresh R3 authorization that dispatches the trusted-main GET-only reporter for the completed build whose runtime activation is unresolved.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: An explicit repository-owner workflow dispatch or exact R3 issue comment supplies the current trusted main SHA while Incident #4953 remains open.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Before any metadata write, the bridge validates the explicit main SHA, fresh R3 authorization comment, unchanged target workflow blob, exact completed build UUID, current protected Production SHA, and absence of prior R3 markers; then it dispatches the unchanged GET-only evidence workflow and records its run ID.
steps: Resolve and validate the explicit expected main SHA before the first write.
Validate authorization comment 5162200620, account, domain, exact build UUID, Production SHA, merge timestamp, GET-only methods, and false mutation boundaries.
Verify the target workflow blob and open incident state.
Reject execution if main, Production, workflow blob, authorization, incident state, or one-time R3 markers diverge.
Record one R3 claim, dispatch the trusted workflow with bounded inputs, and record the target run ID.
assertions: Every write-capable execution path requires and verifies an explicit expected main SHA.
The exact completed build UUID is bound in authorization and R3 metadata markers.
The bridge never receives or references the Hostinger secret value.
The target workflow alone reads secrets.HOSTINGER_API_TOKEN on trusted main.
Provider operations remain GET-only with no build creation, deployment, restart, or provider mutation.
No repository contents mutation outside the reviewed PR, protected-ref mutation, force push, SQL, migration Apply, database mutation, or external send occurs.
The R3 authorization cannot be reused after a claim or dispatch marker exists.

phases.objective: Produce one authenticated artifact containing redacted logs and source/activation signals for build 019fc51c-3947-7255-aa4d-f55cb8df7658.
Confirm fail-closed behavior for changed main, Production, workflow blob, build UUID authorization, incident state, or R3 markers.
This bridge dispatches evidence only and performs no provider canary.
This bridge does not deploy, restart, or mutate Production.
